candidate_gate: Only if canonical current results are empty: top score>=.80 AND gap>=.025 AND at least one explicit multilingual requested field AND every requested field present in source body AND existing EvidenceCoverage allows/covers; no topic aliases.
limits: Real canonical E5/SPM/SQLite observations; policy candidates evaluated externally without production changes. Handwritten multilingual synthetic queries are not fluent-speaker acceptance. No NMT, cloud, model copying or physical-device proof.

pin_variant_posthoc.method: No model rerun. Treat the Gurmukhi spelling ਪਿਨ as explicit PIN in addition to ਪਿੰਨ; source workshop code contains no PIN/passcode/unlock-code field, so that candidate is rejected. Other decisions unchanged.

recommendation: Do not ship the tested .80/.025 explicit-field fallback: it introduces false-topic code retrieval even after PIN spelling repair. Generic field presence does not establish the requested subject/entity. Existing lexical/source coverage also requires separate fixes.
